title: Throwing Target Garden
shareTitle: Throwing Target Garden — Numbers, Colors, and Sequences
description: Listen, aim, and send soft beanbags into a safe landing basket while a handmade felt garden practices numbers, colors, and sequences. Private local camera tracking and Touch Toss are equal ways to play.
learningGoals: Match red, yellow, and blue across speech, objects, and targets
Practice gentle underhand aim into a safe soft landing basket
interactionModel: choose private local camera tracking and toss a soft colored object into a secured basket, or use Touch Toss to flick it toward a generous number, color, or sequence target
feedbackModel: large felt garden-match motion, warm spoken redirects, progress without scores or miss counts, and an authored safe-basket goal

modes.title: Number Hunt
modes.skill: spoken numeral recognition and spatial aiming
